duplicate_policy: Remove exact full-row duplicates within each source file, keeping the first occurrence. Repeated sensor values at different run times are retained. Never deduplicate across session boundaries.
invalid_value_policy: Parse values numerically; non-numeric and non-finite values become missing and are counted. Pad short rows at the end to match the declared header. Do not apply undocumented physical ranges or label unusual values as faults.

operating_conditions.file_mode_source: filename prefixes documented in local README
operating_conditions.stationary_engine_running: VEHICLE_SPEED == 0 and ENGINE_RPM > 0; descriptive condition only.
